reviewer: claude, from frames and the issue text

steps.action: Blender 3.6.0 Beta, Geometry Nodes: Curve Circle (Resolution 8, Radius 1 m) + Curve Line (0,0,0 to 0,0,1) -> Curve to Mesh -> Extrude Mesh (Faces, Selection = Index == 1, Offset Scale 1.000, Individual off) -> Delete Geometry (Face, Selection = Index == B) -> Group Output; spreadsheet shows vertex positions
with B = 7 one face of the extruded block is missing in the viewport; the user orbits the viewport
mutes Delete Geometry (viewport shows the full extruded mesh), later mutes Extrude Mesh (00:47, plain 8-sided open cylinder), then unmutes and keeps changing B
leaves Blender via the Windows Start menu and reads node_geo_extrude_mesh.cc on github.com, searching for 'individu' (02:02-02:23)
back in Blender, B = 8, Individual off: a side face of the extruded block is deleted (a hole in the block)
with Individual on, changes B (9, later 11) to find which face now has which index

actual: With the same Delete Geometry selection (Index == 8), the deleted face changes when Individual is toggled: at 02:31.0 (Individual off) a side face of the extruded block is gone; at 02:32.5 (Individual on) the block looks closed from the same view. With Individual on, a side hole appears with B = 9 (02:45.0) and B = 11 (02:55). The vertex position column in the spreadsheet (20 rows) does not change at the toggle.
decisive: 02:31.0 vs 02:32.5: same Index == 8 deletion, Individual off removes a side face of the extruded block, Individual on removes a different face (block appears closed from this angle)
not_visible: a face index overlay or the spreadsheet Face domain - the order is only probed indirectly by deleting the face with a chosen index
the author's statement of what order he expects
notes: 3 min 6 s of mostly static UI at 1920x1080; node values are only readable at full resolution. About 20 s is spent in a browser reading Blender source code (01:58-02:24). Before 02:31 Individual is unchecked in every sampled frame (00:01, 00:14, 00:36, 00:47, 01:18, 02:30); I did not inspect every second of 00:50-01:57, where B is changed several times.
